name: spinner_of_souls_reveals_until_a_creature
note: Spinner of Souls: 'Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, you may reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. Put that card into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.' P0's Bear dies; P0 reveals (fire): Land, Land, then Lib Beast, which goes to the hand; both Lands go under the library (random order; they share a name). Red before 2026-11-13 (with this record): the move of the Beast closed the reveal's window, and only one Land went to the bottom.
